purpose: Authoritative application-owned (public schema) baseline for bootstrapping a new isolated Pilot Supabase project (M1B). Not migration replay; not Demo business data.

authorities.schema_authority: live IQ Demo public schema (read-only pg_dump --schema-only)
authorities.ci_only_delta: repository_authority differs from runtime only by PR #131 CI/test tooling

source.extraction: pg_dump --schema-only --schema=public --no-publications --no-subscriptions (owner + grants retained); post-processed to drop the single 'CREATE SCHEMA public;' statement

baseline_file.note: File SHA is point-in-time: pg_dump 17.11 emits a random per-dump \restrict token, so the file bytes are not reproducible. Provenance/drift is anchored on the deterministic structural fingerprint below.

structural_fingerprint.algorithm: deploy/pilot/baseline/fingerprint.sql — canonical, OID/timestamp/row-count-free structural digest over public tables/columns/constraints/indexes/functions(owner+secdef+search_path)/triggers/policies/RLS+FORCE/views/matviews/grants; SHA-256 of the ordered blob

extensions_required.note: Extension implementation objects are NOT dumped; the target platform (or the disposable test harness) supplies them.

security.audit_chain_present_evidence: identical Demo-vs-baseline structural fingerprint (all 169 functions incl. sbiq_verify_audit_chain/_range + compute_audit_chain_hash + triggers trg_audit_chain/trg_audit_events_immutable)

b_series_present: B1-B13.1 database objects present (verified by identical Demo-vs-baseline fingerprint)
business_data: NONE (schema-only; zero-business-data assertion passed on fresh apply)
intentional_exclusions: guardian schema (out of IQ pilot scope)
cron job rows + cron schema implementation
database/platform roles (supplied by platform; test harness stubs only)
